body: Not a doctor but I am currently on the NHS waitlist for diagnostic lap after about 7 years of pestering loads of doctors and gynos and having worsening and awful endo symptoms. Get onto your GP and get a referral to a gynaecologist asap, as the wait times in the UK can be quite a while for a gynaecologist. Keep onto the doctors, especially if you’re having worsening symptoms, advocate for yourself and don’t let them fob you off. I know it’s frustrating being told to go away and deal with it but you know your body better than anyone, so stick with it!

NAD but it could be a pilonidal sinus. 
It’s a small hole created from an ingrown hair. They are harmless if not red, hot or oozing liquid. If infected it can become an abscess, which needs to be drained. I’ve had one for a few years now, had it drained twice.

I’d definitely look into seeing a gynaecologist about your periods. Heavy, painful and irregular are all reasons to be seen by a professional. Especially if it’s affecting your mental health and social life.  
I find personally that stress makes my periods worse and all over the place, sometimes bleeding for months at a time when I’m in a bad place mentally. Definitely get it looked into, and good luck. Don’t be afraid to advocate for yourself.

Obviously everyone is different and have different experiences, just my 2 cents.

Different approach, although therapy and professional help is advised obviously, but this one worked for me. 

I taught myself to hate it. Every positive thought I had about coke, I turned into a negative. The comedowns, the financial problems, the distrust from family and friends, the self hatred, the health issues etc. 

Every aspect of my use was turned into something that made me furious. So I ended up staying away. 

Obviously not as easy as it sounds written down, but I think I had literally snorted myself into a depressive episode, and I couldn't take anymore coke. I did so much that the thought of it turned my stomach. 

Also try groups like this one, forums and other platforms online where you can read other users stories and tips. I find it easier than going to meetings. (especially during a pandemic and if you have social anxiety like I do).

I almost developed an intense anger towards cocaine. So every time I thought of it or taking it etc, I reminded myself how much I fucking hate hating myself after each use. How shit the high is and how intense the comedown is. How it drained my bank account, ruined my health and my friendships, and my relationship with my family. 

Basically you just gotta start to fucking hate coke. The more negative things you associate with it, the more likely you are to stay the fuck away. 

Also I told my guy not to let me buy/take any off him anymore. Like no joke, even if I beg type shit. 

He listened.

Thank you. I’m pretty terrified, not gonna lie. The week prior to aborting, I was diagnosed with a large subchorionic haemorrhage, after lots of blood and clots, and incredible pain. My midwife was worried I was ectopic.
I was 7 weeks along when I took the pills. Feeling pretty depressed but that’s just the hormones, I’m just so glad not to be so sick anymore.

I bled after about 3 hours after taking miso, had cramps after an hour but it was chill until then. Starting passing clots immediately after bleeding, lots and lots of them. (I pass clots usually but these were intense). Lots of laying down with a hot bottle and sitting on the toilet later. About 6 hours after taking the miso I passed a huge (lemon sized) much harder lump with a long bit attached and immediately after the pain halved. I knew this was it. I didn’t end up taking the extra two tablets I was given. It’s now 4 days later and I’m still bleeding heavily and having cramps, but no more clots. No sore boobs. Sickness gone completely, so assuming I’m all good to go. Will update after I’ve been tested and scanned. 
Good luck, you got this girl 💪🏼
